description.text: An enhanced expansion pack released on 26 April 2019, the last expansion pack released in Japan's Heisei era. Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno-GX, the first TAG TEAM of three Pokémon, with 300 HP, leads it; its GX attack can do 110 damage to each of three of the opponent's Pokémon. Rowlet & Alolan Exeggutor-GX is its other TAG TEAM, with Keldeo-GX and Naganadel-GX and the Supporter Jessie & James. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 54, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare U-Turn Board, Viridian Forest and Recycle Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Unified Minds in August 2019.
